title: Eleven in 1974, Four in 2003
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：staff　|　正文 314 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 staff 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① staff of the hotel numbered eleven in 1974 and four in 2003, and my mother, who was one of the four and had been one of the eleven, said the number was the whole story and nobody wanted to hear it, and that a staff is not a family and should never be called one.

The ② teaching staff at my school lost three of their number in 1981 and never replaced them. My mother said a ③ staff that is short does not work less, it works differently, and that the difference is invisible to anybody who has never been on one.

In 1998 she was in hospital for eleven weeks, and I watched the ④ staff there do the same thing: a ward of eleven beds, four nurses, and nobody ever appearing to hurry. She said the ⑤ medical staff had taught her more about work than thirty-one years in the hotel, and that the staff on a night shift know more than the doctors and are never asked.

My grandfather had a ⑥ walking staff cut from ash in 1952, and he leaned on it for thirty-one years and never once called it a stick. My mother said the ⑦ staff of office the mayor carried was the same thing with a ribbon on it, and that neither of them could hold anybody up. He had been a ⑧ staff sergeant in 1945, which he never mentioned and which she found out only from his papers.

The hotel closed in 2011 and the staff were given eleven minutes to clear their lockers. My mother, who had been one of them for thirty-one years, said it was not cruelty but arithmetic. The ⑨ staff of four she had ended with met once a year until 2019; she never told me what was said. I have never met any of the ⑩ staff members she worked beside, and I never will.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n.[集合] 全体职工；全体雇员
B. n.[pl.] （个别的）员工；职员（staff members）
C. n. 手杖；拐杖；棍棒（a walking staff）
D. n. 权杖；权标（a staff of office）
E. n. 全体教师；教职员工（the teaching staff）
F. n. 全体医务人员（the medical staff）
G. n. 参谋；参谋军士（staff sergeant）
H. n. 班底；全班人马（a staff of four）

items.q: The staff of the hotel numbered eleven
The teaching staff at my school
the medical staff had taught her
a walking staff cut from ash
the staff of office the mayor carried
The staff of four she had ended with

answers.why: the staff 意为“全体职工”，1974 年旅馆的员工有十一人，2003 年只剩四人。
the teaching staff 意为“全体教师、教职员工”，我学校 1981 年少了三名教师。
a staff 意为“全体职工（作为一个整体）”，人手不足的一班人不是做得少，而是做法不同。
the staff 在此指“医院的全体医务人员／医护人员”，十一张床、四名护士，没人显得匆忙。
the medical staff 意为“医务人员”，她说他们教给她的关于工作的东西比旅馆三十一年还多。
a walking staff 意为“手杖、拐杖”，我祖父那根是 1952 年用白蜡木削成的。
a staff of office 意为“权杖、权标”，母亲说市长拿的那根是同一种东西，只多了一条缎带。
staff sergeant 意为“参谋军士（军衔）”，1945 年他是参谋军士，却从未提起过。
a staff of four 意为“四人的班底／全班人马”，她最后共事的那个四人班底每年聚一次。
staff members 意为“（一个一个的）员工、职员”，我从未见过与她共事的任何一位员工。

我祖父有一根 1952 年用白蜡木削成的手杖。（a walking staff）
她说市长拿的那根权杖是同一种东西，只是多了一条缎带。（the staff of office）

The teaching staff at my school lost three of their number in 1981.
In hospital I watched the staff there do the same thing.
She said the medical staff had taught her more about work than thirty-one years in the hotel.
My grandfather had a walking staff cut from ash in 1952.
She said the staff of office the mayor carried was the same thing with a ribbon on it.
